Functions

Functions you call directly, without an object.

createGame

createGame([options])

Creates a whole game with sensible defaults: its canvas (scaled to fit the window), mouse, touch and keyboard input, and drawing. A p5 function once p5.clickery is loaded, or p.createGame in instance mode.

ParameterTypeMeaning
optionsGameOptionsoptionalSee GameOptions. Everything has a default.

Returns Game The game. Call game.start() in setup() and game.draw() in draw().

Example

let game;

async function setup() {
  game = createGame({ rooms: [yard] });
  await game.start();
}

function draw() {
  game.draw();
}

createGameCanvas

createGameCanvas(width, height)

A normal p5 canvas that also remembers its logical size. createGame calls it for you; use it only when you build a game from the parts yourself.

ParameterTypeMeaning
widthnumberWhole number of pixels.
heightnumberWhole number of pixels.

Returns Object The p5 renderer. Throws a RangeError for anything but positive whole numbers.

registerClickery

registerClickery(p5)

Registers p5.clickery with p5. The script tag does this by itself; with ES modules call it once, before new p5(...).

ParameterTypeMeaning
p5functionThe p5 class.

Example

import { registerClickery } from './p5.clickery.esm.js';
registerClickery(p5);
